_comment: orleans_route_farm: generated by make_route_tilesets.py from recipes/orleans_route.json. Orleans route secondary: the bayou terrain set (Ekat99 swamp tiles, cypress, reeds, logs, snags, tall grass), Olivine/Route 40 dock, Brick City sailboat, Soul House stone, path inner corners. No town buildings. See tools/mapgen/CREDITS.md. Landmarks for routes: Shady cabin (sheds, shacks, boathouses), Moomoo barn (mills, warehouses), Cianwood boulders and a cave mouth.
